reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes joining a OneCoin team as a way to achieve goals and displays a WhatsApp contact overlay that may provide a route for follow-up. Much of the material also presents blockchain as an educational or business topic, and the available video evidence does not establish a payment request, victim loss, or a confirmed connection between the OneCoin wording and the Grant Thornton discussion.

citations.quote: JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS JOIN US
Blockchain technology is the innovation that is revolutionizing the financial sector.
In smart contracts, there are conditions and terms that can be automatically executed when a condition is met.
to help them explore possible developments and possible uses of this new technology

opening.argument: The material presents blockchain as a technical subject, not as a guaranteed financial opportunity. It explains that transactions can occur without intermediaries, describes distributed databases and consensus, and says blockchain networks may be private, public, or consortium-based. It also presents smart contracts as conditional systems that execute when a condition is met, rather than promising automatic profits. The discussion is framed in qualified, analytical language: banks are described as “privileged players for starting to invest,” while experts are said to believe blockchain will open “new niches and market areas,” not that viewers will earn money. The available visuals likewise focus on blockchain diagrams, technical concepts, and business presentations. Nothing supplied states a guaranteed return, required payment, or risk-free outcome.

citations.quote: It allows transactions between two participants without the need for intermediaries to verify them.
In addition, blockchain network can be privatised, public or consortium.
In smart contracts, there are conditions and terms that can be automatically executed when a condition is met.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The invitation wording is brief and does not explain a commission plan, payment, tiers, or promised income. A WhatsApp overlay provides a contact route, but does not establish what a viewer would be asked to do. The prosecution's own cited blockchain excerpts describe technical operation and possible business uses, which are consistent with an educational presentation rather than deceptive solicitation.

The information from the transactions is grouped in blocks, is immutable and protected in a shared network

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of a stated payment or guaranteed return does not resolve the explicit recruitment signal. The description directly says “JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS JOIN US,” and the frames visibly retain a WhatsApp contact overlay. Technical explanations can provide credibility around a recruitment pitch; they do not erase the invitation to join. The quoted discussion of blockchain's uses does not show that the OneCoin team invitation is merely academic.

citations.quote: JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS JOIN US
to help them explore possible developments and possible uses of this new technology

opening.argument: The video's dominant substance is an explanation of blockchain technology and its applications. It defines the distributed ledger as a replicated database, explains consensus validation, describes immutable transaction history, and discusses smart contracts and digital signatures. The accompanying images show blockchain diagrams and presentations involving business professionals, reinforcing a technology-and-business seminar format. The narration also discusses investigating developments with clients and companies and learning how to apply the technology in day-to-day businesses. That is tutorial or professional commentary: it teaches how the system works and where it might be used. The supplied material does not show a registration process, payment instructions, income calculation, or a step-by-step recruitment funnel.

citations.quote: I believe that the blockchain and the technology, behind which we would call the distributed ledger, would be equivalent to a distributed accounting book.
It would be a distributed database replicated among all participants.
In smart contracts, there are conditions and terms that can be automatically executed when a condition is met.
to help them explore possible developments and possible uses of this new technology and to learn how to apply it in their day-to-day businesses.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution identifies a recruitment phrase, but it does not show that this phrase is the video's dominant purpose. Most of the supplied narration is a technical explanation, including consensus, immutability, smart contracts, and applications across sectors. The Grant Thornton presentation imagery and discussion of clients and companies further support a professional technology context. A contact overlay alone cannot convert an otherwise educational presentation into a demonstrated scam mechanism.

citations.quote: Bonds, shares, registers, properties transfers, certifications, the applications in different sectors are vast but some are leading.
We have been doing follow-up on the development of this not only in Spain but worldwide

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Technical content may be present, but the explicit OneCoin team invitation is still part of the video's observable message. The description does not say “study blockchain”; it says “JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM” and “ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS.” The business-seminar visuals do not establish that the invitation is educational, and the technical discussion cannot prove that viewers were not being directed toward recruitment. The argument therefore relies on context while leaving the clearest call to join unexplained.

citations.quote: JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS JOIN US

opening.argument: Even treating the invitation as promotional, the evidence supports at most an ordinary business or technology referral context, not a demonstrated scam. The material discusses blockchain's potential uses in bonds, shares, property transfers, certifications, and financial-sector operations. It describes collaboration with startup companies and helping businesses explore possible developments. Crucially, nothing supplied shows a deposit, purchase price, promised return, downline income, commission, tiered matrix, credential request, or claimed ability to recover money. The phrase about joining a team is too underspecified to establish how money would move or what outcome would be guaranteed. The WhatsApp overlay is a contact detail, not proof of deceptive conduct. On the record available, the safer reading is business promotion or networking around a technology.

JOIN OUR ONECOIN TEAM ACHIEVE YOUR GOALS JOIN US

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's case identifies a team invitation but not the commercial mechanism behind it. “Achieve your goals” is vague promotional language; it does not state earnings, commissions, required purchases, or recruitment compensation. The technical discussion lists legitimate categories of blockchain use and describes work with companies, while the visual contact overlay does not reveal what service would be offered. Without the missing mechanism, labeling the promotion a scam goes beyond the supplied evidence.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The prosecution need not prove every downstream feature to identify the observed recruitment signal. The supplied description explicitly invites viewers to join a OneCoin team, and the frames show a WhatsApp contact overlay that may facilitate follow-up. The absence of a visible deposit or commission schedule limits how specifically the conduct can be characterized, but it does not transform a direct team-recruitment invitation into ordinary technology commentary. The blockchain material may function as supporting legitimacy rather than a separate service.
